children: Indivior entered into a Deed of Variation and Termination with Reckitt Benckiser Healthcare to accelerate the end of their Copacker Supply Agreement for SUBOXONE and SUBUTEX tablets to January 15, 2027. The agreement will remain in force until that date, with RB manufacturing additional units. Indivior will pay capped, non-material costs related to lower volumes, asset disposal, depreciation, redundancy, incentives and potential third-party costs. Indivior has identified a new supplier, with obligations contingent on validation of the new manufacturer’s process.
